comparison.objective: Keep a station supplied one block at a time for another arm operating on a fixed clock.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed replenishment, pick-and-place, and shared-workspace collision avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Fraction of six blocks taken and crated; any contact between arms scores zero.
comparison.reason: Tests paced machine tending and temporal coordination rather than physical parameter adjustment and response validation.
